applicable_when: The kernel operates on only 2400 elements (96x25). With XBLOCK=128 and YBLOCK=8, the grid is just 12 CTAs covering only 9% of the 132 SMs on the H200. Achieved occupancy is 6.2% vs 100% theoretical. Shrinking tile sizes so more blocks are launched spreads work across more SMs. XBLOCK=32 and YBLOCK=1 yields grid=(1x96)=96 blocks, covering 73% of SMs. Adding @triton.autotune lets the runtime pick the best configuration automatically. This directly addresses the LaunchConfiguration (90.91% speedup) and AchievedOccupancy (90.12% speedup) rules.
